location.title: Close to Chios. Closer to the sea.

location.amenitiesBody: Within walking distance: fresh local bakery, supermarket, beachfront tavernas, cafés, pharmacy, and bus service connecting to the island.

heritage.title: The Spirit of Mastiha
heritage.p1: On the southern hillsides of Chios grows the Pistacia lentiscus var. Chia, the only tree in the world that weeps authentic mastiha resin. Inscribed by UNESCO in 2014, the centuries-old practice of 'kentima' (scoring the bark to yield fragrant teardrops) defines the quiet perseverance and warmth of the island.
heritage.p2: Our suites draw inspiration from this rare gem: clear amber light, organic textures, and hospitality shaped by authentic island heritage.
